## Change

Describe the user-visible outcome and why it is needed.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and preview results.

## Production Gate

- [ ] This change arrived through a branch and pull request; it was not pushed directly to `main`
- [ ] Relevant build, formatting, and public-boundary checks pass
- [ ] The AI stopped at this PR and did not approve it, enable auto-merge, or merge it
- [ ] The human owner personally reviewed the final diff, preview, and check results
- [ ] The human owner will perform the production merge in GitHub
- [ ] Deployment and live-site verification will be recorded separately after the human merge
